question: Select exactly the option letters that are still true after the conversation. Answer with option letters only.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! They must have felt so appreciated. It's awesome to see the difference we can make in each other's lives. Any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy stuff coming up?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yay! Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that sounds awesome! Can't wait to see your art - got any previews?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Check out my painting for the art show! Hope you like it.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that painting is awesome! Those colors are so vivid and the whole thing looks really unified. What inspired you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I painted this after I visited a LGBTQ center. I wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! It really conveys unity and strength - such a gorgeous piece! My kids and I just finished another painting like our last one.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Melanie! Just wanted to say hi!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Good to talk to you again. What's up? Anything new since last time?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Mel! A lot's happened since we last chatted - I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. I'm meeting so many cool people who are as passionate as I am about rights and community support. I'm giving my voice and making a real difference, plus it's fulfilling in so many ways. It's just great, you know?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's awesome, Caroline! Glad to hear you found a great group where you can have an impact. Bet it feels great to be able to speak your truth and stand up for what's right. Want to tell me a bit more about it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! It's awesome to have our own platform to be ourselves and support others' rights. Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, to get together and support each other.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, your group sounds awesome! Supporting each other and making good things happen - that's so inspiring! Have you been part of any events or campaigns lately?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Last weekend our city held a pride parade! So many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs and celebrating love and diversity. I missed it but it was a powerful reminder that we are not alone in this fight for equality and inclusivity. Change is possible!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, fantastic, Caroline! Bet the atmosphere was incredible. Oh yeah, we went to the beach recently. It was awesome! The kids had such a blast.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sounds fun! What was the best part? Do you do it often with the kids?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year. But those times are always special to spend time together and chill.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sounds special, those beach trips! Do you have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel, that's awesome! What's your best camping memory?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Cool! What did it look like?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel. That must've been breathtaking!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: It was one of those moments where I felt tiny and in awe of the universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - so many little moments like that.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's great, Mel! What other good memories do you have that make you feel thankful for life?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Aw, that's sweet, Mel! Those milestones are great reminders of how special our bonds are.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, they sure are. It's special moments like these that make me appreciate life and how lucky I am to be with my family and have our love.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Melanie, what a beautiful moment! Lucky you to have such an awesome family!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I'm really lucky to have my family; they bring so much joy and love.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Last night was amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze. Seeing my kids' smiles was so awesome, and I'm so thankful for our special moments together.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for your kids is so awesome. What concert was it? The advocacy event was a cool experience - so much love and support, amazing!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It was Matt Patterson, he is so talented! His voice and songs were amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting going on?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel, glad you had a blast at the concert. A lot's happened since we talked. I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that's awesome! How did it feel being part of that community?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: It was so inspiring, Mel! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! That sounds awesome. This pic's from last night - looks like everyone was having a blast! Reminds me it's important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for our kids. How do you stay inclusive in your work as an artist?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That pic is cool! Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance. Here's a recent painting!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that rocks! What's the main idea of your art?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: My art is about expressing my trans experience. It's my way of showing my story and helping people understand the trans community.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Your art's amazing, Caroline. I love how you use it to tell your stories and teach people about trans folks. I'd love to see another painting of yours!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Here's one- 'Embracing Identity' is all about finding comfort and love in being yourself. The woman in the painting stands for the journey of acceptance. My aim was to show warmth, love and self-acceptance.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's gorgeous! I love the self-acceptance and love theme. How does art help you with your self-discovery and acceptance journey?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Art's allowed me to explore my transition and my changing body. It's been a great way to work through stuff I'm going through. I love that it teaches me to accept the beauty of imperfections.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's so cool! Art can be so healing and a way to really connect with who you are. It's awesome that beauty can be found in the imperfections. We're all individual and wonderfully imperfect. Thanks for sharing it with me!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. It means a lot to share this with you.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Great chatting with you! Feel free to reach out any time.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Mel! How're ya doin'? Recently, I had a not-so-great experience on a hike. I ran into a group of religious conservatives who said something that really upset me. It made me think how much work we still have to do for LGBTQ rights. It's been so helpful to have people around me who accept and support me, so I know I'll be ok!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline, sorry about the hike. It sucks when people are so closed-minded. Strong support really helps. FYI, I finished another pottery project - want to see a pic?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sure thing, Melanie! Can't wait to see your pottery project. I'm happy you found something that makes you happy. Show me when you can!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Here it is. Pretty proud of it! It was a great experience. Thoughts?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That bowl is awesome, Mel! What gave you the idea for all the colors and patterns?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I'm obsessed with those, so I made something to catch the eye and make people smile. Plus, painting helps me express my feelings and be creative. Each stroke carries a part of me.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's amazing! You put so much effort and passion into it. Your creativity really shines. Seeing how art can be a source of self-expression and growth is truly inspiring. You're killing it!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Your words really mean a lot. I've always felt a strong connection to art, and it's been a huge learning experience. It's both a sanctuary and a source of comfort. I'm so glad to have something that brings me so much happiness and fulfillment.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Glad you found something that makes you so happy! Surrounding ourselves with things that bring us joy is important. Life's too short to do anything else!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Agreed, Caroline. Life's tough but it's worth it when we have things that make us happy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Definitely, Mel! Finding those happy moments and clinging to them is key. It's what keeps us going, even when life's hard. I'm lucky to have people like you to remind me.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, same here Caroline. You make life's struggles more bearable.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! It means a lot having you in my corner. Appreciate our friendship!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I appreciate our friendship too, Caroline. You've always been there for me.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm always here for you, Mel! We had a blast last year at the Pride fest. Those supportive friends definitely make everything worth it!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That was a blast! So much fun with the whole gang! Wanna do a family outing this summer?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Right, it was so much fun! We could do a family outting, or wanna plan something special for this summer, just us two? It'd be a great chance to catch up and explore nature! What do you think?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Sounds great, Caroline! Let's plan something special!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Sounds great, Mel! We'll make some awesome memories!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, Caroline! I'll start thinking about what we can do.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, Mel! Life's all about creating memories. Can't wait for the trip!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hi Melanie! Hope you're doing good. Guess what I did this week? I took the first step towards becoming a mom - I applied to adoption agencies! It's a big decision, but I think I'm ready to give all my love to a child. I got lots of help from this adoption advice/assistance group I attended. It was great!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, congrats! So proud of you for taking this step. How does it feel? Also, do you have any pets?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Exciting but kinda nerve-wracking. Parenting's such a big responsibility. And yup, I do- Oscar, my guinea pig. He's been great. How are your pets?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, it's normal to be both excited and nervous with a big decision. And thanks for asking, they're good- we got another cat named Bailey too. Here's a pic of Oliver. Can you show me one of Oscar?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: He's so cute! What’s the funniest thing Oliver's done? And sure, check out this pic of him eating parsley! Veggies are his fave!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Oliver's hilarious! He hid his bone in my slipper once! Cute, right? Almost as silly as when I got to feed a horse a carrot.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That's so funny! I used to go horseback riding with my dad when I was a kid, we'd go through the fields, feeling the wind. It was so special. I've always had a love for horses!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that sounds great - I agree, they're awesome. Here's a photo of my horse painting I did recently.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Melanie, that's amazing! Love all the details and how you got the horse's grace and strength. Do you like painting animals?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! Glad you like it. Yeah, I love to. It's peaceful and special. Horses have such grace! Do you like to paint too?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Painting's great for expressing myself. I love creating art! Here's a recent self-portrait I made last week.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, that's great! The blue's really powerful, huh? How'd you feel while painting it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! I felt liberated and empowered doing it. Painting helps me explore my identity and be true to myself. It's definitely therapeutic.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's great! Art's awesome for showing us who we really are and getting in touch with ourselves. What else helps you out?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. Art gives me a sense of freedom, but so does having supportive people around, promoting LGBTQ rights and being true to myself. I want to live authentically and help others to do the same.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! That's amazing. You really care about being real and helping others. Wishing you the best on your adoption journey!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I really appreciate it. Excited for the future! Bye!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Bye Caroline. I'm here for you. Take care of yourself.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey, Mel! How's it going? There's something I want to tell you. I went hiking last week and got into a bad spot with some people. It really bugged me, so I tried to apologize to them.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! Sorry that happened to you. It's tough when those things happen, but it's great you apologized. Takes a lot of courage and maturity! What do you think of this?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! That plate is awesome! Did you make it?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, I made it in pottery class yesterday. I love it! Pottery's so relaxing and creative. Have you tried it yet?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Nah, I haven't. I've been busy painting - here's something I just finished.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow Caroline, that looks amazing! Those colors are so vivid, it really looks like a real sunset. What gave you the idea to paint it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I painted it after I visited the beach last week. Just seeing the sun dip below the horizon, all the amazing colors - it was amazing and calming. So I just had to try to capture that feeling in my painting.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, the beach really inspired you. The art really took me to that moment and I can feel the serenity. You captured the sunset perfectly, so peaceful!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks Mel, really appreciate your kind words. It means a lot to me that you can feel the sense of peace and serenity. Makes me feel connected.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I feel the same way! Art is so cool like that - it connects us and helps us understand each other. I was actually just remembering yesterday, spending the day with my fam volunteering at a homeless shelter. It was hard to see how neglected some people are, but it was great to feel like we could make a difference.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel, you're amazing! Volunteering and making a difference- it's so heartwarming. You're an inspiration to us all!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! I really appreciate your help and motivation. What made you decide to transition and join the transgender community?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Finding a community where I'm accepted, loved and supported has really meant a lot to me. It's made a huge difference to have people who get what I'm going through. Stuff like this mural are really special to me!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Caroline, glad you found a supportive community! Can you tell me more about why it's special to you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: The rainbow flag mural is important to me as it reflects the courage and strength of the trans community. The eagle symbolizes freedom and pride, representing my own resilience and that of others.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm in awe of your courage as a trans person. Have you made any more art lately?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! I made this stained glass window to remind myself and others that within us all is the key to discovering our true potential and living our best life.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that looks amazing! What inspired it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks! It was made for a local church and shows time changing our lives. I made it to show my own journey as a transgender woman and how we should accept growth and change.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! All those colors are incredible and the story it tells is so inspiring.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Glad you like it. It's a symbol of togetherness, to celebrate differences and be that much closer. I'd love to make something like this next!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, that's gorgeous! Where did you find it?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I was out walking in my neighborhood when I came across this cool rainbow sidewalk for Pride Month. It was so vibrant and welcoming, I had to take a picture! It reminds us that love and acceptance are everywhere—even where we least expect it.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's so nice, Caroline! Art can be in the most unlikely places. Love and acceptance really can be found everywhere.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Agreed, Mel! Art can be a real mood-booster - I saw someone drawing on the ground the other day and it made me so happy. Creativity sure can lighten someone's day.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's so nice! The colors are so bright and the flowers are so pretty. Art is such a source of joy.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Mel! Art gives me so much joy. It helps me show my feelings and freeze gorgeous moments, like a bouquet of flowers.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, did you make that? It looks so real!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah, definitely! Drawing flowers is one of my faves. Appreciating nature and sharing it is great. What about you, Mel? What type of art do you love?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Painting landscapes and still life is my favorite! Nature's amazing, here's a painting I did recently.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, Mel! Any more paintings coming up?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm feeling inspired by autumn so I'm planning a few. You got any cool art projects coming up?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm putting together an LGBTQ art show next month and I'm gonna show my paintings. Super stoked!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that's awesome! Can't wait to see your show - the LGBTQ community needs more platforms like this!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah Mel, stoked! Gonna be a great night featuring LGBTQ artists and their awesome talents. We want it to spread understanding and acceptance - let's make it happen!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Melanie, great to hear from you. What's been up since we talked?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! Since we last spoke, I took my kids to a park yesterday. They had fun exploring and playing. It was nice seeing them have a good time outdoors. Time flies, huh? What's new with you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, your kids had so much fun at the park! Being outdoors can be really enjoyable. A lot happened since our last chat. I've been chasing my ambitions and had the chance to volunteer at an LGBTQ+ youth center. It was so gratifying to talk to similar young people. It made me remember how essential it is to be kind and show support.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That sounds great, Caroline. Volunteering is a great way to meet people. Creating community and supporting each other, especially for kids, is really important. How did you feel about your time there? Anything that sticks out to you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I loved it. It was awesome to see how strong the young people were, with all the challenges they face. I felt fulfilled guiding and supporting them. I even got to let them know they're not alone by sharing my story. Such a powerful, emotional experience.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Was connecting with those young folks meaningful for you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: It was so special to me. It reminded me of my own struggles in the past and how I felt alone. I was glad I could share my story and offer them support - it felt like I could make a difference.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's great. Sharing your story and support might make a difference for a long time. What do you hope to do next time?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm definitely carrying on volunteering at the youth center. It's an important part of my life and I've made strong connections with people there. I really believe in community and supporting each other. So I wanna keep making a difference.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's great news, Caroline! Love seeing your dedication to helping others. Any specific projects or activities you're looking forward to there?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: We're putting together a talent show for the kids next month. I'm looking forward to seeing how much fun everyone has and how proud they'll feel of their talents!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's so cool, Caroline! That's a great way to show off and be proud of everyone's skills. You know I love live music. Can't wait to hear about it!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow! Did you see that band?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, that pic was from a show I went to. It was so much fun and reminded me of how music brings us together.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Wow, what a fun moment! What's the band?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: "Summer Sounds"- The playing an awesome pop song that got everyone dancing and singing. It was so fun and lively!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: That sounds great! Music brings us together and brings joy. Playing and singing let me express myself and connect with others - love it! So cathartic and uplifting.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Cool! What type of music do you play?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Guitar's mostly my thing. Playing it helps me get my emotions out.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's awesome! What type of guitar? Been playing long?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I started playing acoustic guitar about five years ago; it's been a great way to express myself and escape into my emotions.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Music's amazing, isn't it? Any songs that have deep meaning for you?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Yeah totally! "Brave" by Sara Bareilles has a lot of significance for me. It's about being courageous and fighting for what's right. Whenever I hear this jam, I think about the paths I've taken and the progress I've made.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: That's a gorgeous song, Caroline. It really fits with your journey and your determination to make a difference. Music can be so inspiring and uplifting.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! Appreciate it. You play any instruments?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Yeah, I play clarinet! Started when I was young and it's been great. Expression of myself and a way to relax.

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Cool! Got any fav tunes?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: I'm a fan of both classical like Bach and Mozart, as well as modern music like Ed Sheeran's "Perfect".

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Hey Mel, long time no chat! I had a wicked day out with the gang last weekend - we went biking and saw some pretty cool stuff. It was so refreshing, and the pic I'm sending is just stunning, eh?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Hey Caroline! It's so good to hear from you! That pic is so beautiful, the colors really pop. Biking sounds like a great way to get out in nature. We went camping with the kids a few weeks ago, had a blast exploring the forest and hiking. Nature can be so refreshing for your soul. Any plans coming up?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Melanie, that photo's amazing! I love all the yellow leaves, it looks so cozy. That sounds like fun! Seeing how excited they get for the little things is awesome, it's so contagious.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It's awesome seeing the kids get excited learning something new about nature. Those moments make being a parent worth it. We roasted marshmallows and shared stories around the campfire. Those simple moments make the best memories. What inspires you with your volunteering?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I'm inspired seeing my work make a difference for the LGBTQ+ community. Knowing I'm helping create a more loving world is amazing. I'm really thankful for my friends, family and mentors' support. It inspires me to keep making art, too.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline, that looks awesome! I love how it shows the togetherness and power you were talking about. How long have you been creating art?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Since I was 17 or so. I find it soempowering and cathartic. It's amazing how art can show things that are hard to put into words. How long have you been into art?

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Seven years now, and I've finally found my real muses: painting and pottery. It's so calming and satisfying. Check out my pottery creation in the pic!

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Melanie, those bowls are amazing! They each have such cool designs. I love that you chose pottery for your art. Painting and drawing have helped me express my feelings and explore my gender identity. Creating art was really important to me during my transition - it helped me understand and accept myself. I'm so grateful.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Thanks, Caroline! It has really helped me out. I love how it's both a creative outlet and a form of therapy. Have you ever thought about trying it or another art form?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: I haven't done pottery yet, but I'm game for trying new art. I might try it sometime! Check out this piece I made!

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caroline! This painting is awesome. Love the red and blue. What gave you the idea?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie! I made this painting to show my path as a trans woman. The red and blue are for the binary gender system, and the mix of colors means smashing that rigid thinking. It's a reminder to love my authentic self - it's taken a while to get here but I'm finally proud of who I am.

turns.speaker: Melanie
turns.text: Wow, Caro, that painting is amazing! You've made so much progress. I'm super proud of you for being your true self. What effect has the journey had on your relationships?

turns.speaker: Caroline
turns.text: Thanks, Melanie. It's definitely changed them. Some close friends kept supporting me, but a few weren't able to handle it. It wasn't easy, but I'm much happier being around those who accept and love me. Now my relationships feel more genuine.

[D9:11] Melanie: Wow, Caroline! They must have felt so appreciated. It's awesome to see the difference we can make in each other's lives. Any other exciting LGBTQ advocacy stuff coming up?
[D9:12] Caroline: Yay! Next month I'm having an LGBTQ art show with my paintings - can't wait!
[D9:13] Melanie: Wow, Caroline, that sounds awesome! Can't wait to see your art - got any previews?
[D9:14] Caroline: Check out my painting for the art show! Hope you like it.
[D9:15] Melanie: Wow, Caroline, that painting is awesome! Those colors are so vivid and the whole thing looks really unified. What inspired you?
[D9:16] Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! I painted this after I visited a LGBTQ center. I wanted to capture everyone's unity and strength.
[D9:17] Melanie: Wow, Caroline! It really conveys unity and strength - such a gorgeous piece! My kids and I just finished another painting like our last one.
[D10:1] Caroline: Hey Melanie! Just wanted to say hi!
[D10:2] Melanie: Hey Caroline! Good to talk to you again. What's up? Anything new since last time?
[D10:3] Caroline: Hey Mel! A lot's happened since we last chatted - I just joined a new LGBTQ activist group last Tues. I'm meeting so many cool people who are as passionate as I am about rights and community support. I'm giving my voice and making a real difference, plus it's fulfilling in so many ways. It's just great, you know?
[D10:4] Melanie: That's awesome, Caroline! Glad to hear you found a great group where you can have an impact. Bet it feels great to be able to speak your truth and stand up for what's right. Want to tell me a bit more about it?
[D10:5] Caroline: Thanks, Melanie! It's awesome to have our own platform to be ourselves and support others' rights. Our group, 'Connected LGBTQ Activists', is made of all kinds of people investing in positive changes. We have regular meetings, plan events and campaigns, to get together and support each other.
[D10:6] Melanie: Wow, Caroline, your group sounds awesome! Supporting each other and making good things happen - that's so inspiring! Have you been part of any events or campaigns lately?
[D10:7] Caroline: Last weekend our city held a pride parade! So many people marched through the streets waving flags, holding signs and celebrating love and diversity. I missed it but it was a powerful reminder that we are not alone in this fight for equality and inclusivity. Change is possible!
[D10:8] Melanie: Wow, fantastic, Caroline! Bet the atmosphere was incredible. Oh yeah, we went to the beach recently. It was awesome! The kids had such a blast.
[D10:9] Caroline: Sounds fun! What was the best part? Do you do it often with the kids?
[D10:10] Melanie: Seeing my kids' faces so happy at the beach was the best! We don't go often, usually only once or twice a year. But those times are always special to spend time together and chill.
[D10:11] Caroline: Sounds special, those beach trips! Do you have any other summer traditions you all do together? Create those memories!
[D10:12] Melanie: We always look forward to our family camping trip. We roast marshmallows, tell stories around the campfire and just enjoy each other's company. It's the highlight of our summer!
[D10:13] Caroline: Wow, Mel, that's awesome! What's your best camping memory?
[D10:14] Melanie: I'll always remember our camping trip last year when we saw the Perseid meteor shower. It was so amazing lying there and watching the sky light up with streaks of light. We all made wishes and felt so at one with the universe. That's a memory I'll never forget.
[D10:15] Caroline: Cool! What did it look like?
[D10:16] Melanie: The sky was so clear and filled with stars, and the meteor shower was amazing - it felt like we were part of something huge and awe-inspiring.
[D10:17] Caroline: Wow, Mel. That must've been breathtaking!
[D10:18] Melanie: It was one of those moments where I felt tiny and in awe of the universe. Reminds me how awesome life is - so many little moments like that.
[D10:19] Caroline: That's great, Mel! What other good memories do you have that make you feel thankful for life?
[D10:20] Melanie: I'll never forget the day my youngest took her first steps. Seeing her wobble as she took those initial steps really put into perspective how fleeting life is and how lucky I am to be able to share these moments.
[D10:21] Caroline: Aw, that's sweet, Mel! Those milestones are great reminders of how special our bonds are.
[D10:22] Melanie: Yeah, they sure are. It's special moments like these that make me appreciate life and how lucky I am to be with my family and have our love.
[D10:23] Caroline: Wow, Melanie, what a beautiful moment! Lucky you to have such an awesome family!
[D10:24] Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! I'm really lucky to have my family; they bring so much joy and love.
[D11:1] Melanie: Hey Caroline! Last night was amazing! We celebrated my daughter's birthday with a concert surrounded by music, joy and the warm summer breeze. Seeing my kids' smiles was so awesome, and I'm so thankful for our special moments together.
[D11:2] Caroline: Wow, sounds wonderful! Your love for your kids is so awesome. What concert was it? The advocacy event was a cool experience - so much love and support, amazing!
[D11:3] Melanie: Thanks, Caroline! It was Matt Patterson, he is so talented! His voice and songs were amazing. What's up with you? Anything interesting going on?
[D11:4] Caroline: Wow, Mel, glad you had a blast at the concert. A lot's happened since we talked. I went to a pride parade last Friday and it was awesome - so much energy and love everywhere. Really made me proud and reminded me how important it is to keep standing up for equality.
[D11:5] Melanie: Wow, that's awesome! How did it feel being part of that community?
[D11:6] Caroline: It was so inspiring, Mel! Check out the crowd. People of all kinds celebrating love and acceptance - it really pushed me to keep fighting for LGBTQ rights.
[D11:7] Melanie: Wow, Caroline! That sounds awesome. This pic's from last night - looks like everyone was having a blast! Reminds me it's important to cultivate a loving and accepting environment for our kids. How do you stay inclusive in your work as an artist?
[D11:8] Caroline: That pic is cool! Representing inclusivity and diversity in my art is important to me. I also use it to speak up for the LGBTQ+ community and push for acceptance. Here's a recent painting!

[D9:2] John: Hey Tim! I know the stress of exams and homework, but you got this! I'm doing OK, cheers for asking. Last week I visited home and caught up with my family and old friends. We had a great time talking about our childhood - it reminds me of the good ol' times!
[D9:3] Tim: Thanks for the pic! That group looks like a great squad. How long did you all play together?
[D9:4] John: We were teammates for four years in high school, so we've played together for quite some time. Have you ever been part of a sports team?
[D9:5] Tim: Nope, never been on a sports team. I'm more into reading and fantasy novels. I love sinking into different magical worlds. It's one of the reasons I love traveling to new places, to experience a different kind of magic.
[D9:6] John: Wow, Tim, that's an awesome book collection! It's cool to escape to different worlds with a hobby. By the way, I love discovering new cities - check out this pic from one of my trips to New York City!
[D9:7] Tim: Wow! That skyline looks amazing - I've been wanting to visit NYC. How was it?
[D9:8] John: Thanks! It was amazing. Everywhere you go there's something new and exciting. Exploring the city and trying all the restaurants was awesome. It's a must-visit!
[D9:9] Tim: Adding NYC to my travel list, sounds like a great adventure! I heard there's so much to explore and try out. Can't wait to visit!
[D9:10] John: Trust me, NYC is amazing! It's got so much to check out - the culture, food - you won't regret it. It's an adventure you'll never forget!
[D9:11] Tim: Woohoo! Sounds like a fun place with lots of potential. Can't wait to experience it for myself!
[D9:12] John: Awesome! Can't wait to hear when you are going. Let me know and I'm sure I can help you out.
[D9:13] Tim: Yep, I'll let you know! Thanks for being so helpful.
[D9:14] John: Sure thing! Any time you need help, don't hesitate to reach out.
[D9:15] Tim: Thanks! Your support means a lot to me. Bye!
[D10:1] Tim: Hey John, it's been a few days! I got a no for a summer job I wanted which wasn't great but I'm staying positive. On your NYC trip, did you have any troubles? How did you handle them?
[D10:2] John: Hey Tim! Sorry to hear about the job, but your positivity will help you find something great! My trip went okay - I had some trouble figuring out the subway at first, but then it was easy after someone helped explain it. How about you? Anything new you've tackled?
[D10:3] Tim: Thanks! Appreciate your encouragement. Yesterday, I tackled something new - I gave a presentation in class. I was nervous but I made it. Small step, but feels like progress.
[D10:4] John: Cool, Tim! Taking the plunge and presenting can be tough, but awesome work! Progress is progress, keep it up. By the way, I've been trying out cooking recipes. Made this tasty soup recently - it was real good!
[D10:5] Tim: Wow, that looks great! How did you make it? Do you have a recipe you can share?
[D10:6] John: Thanks, I just sort of made it up on the spot so I don't have a recipe.
[D10:7] Tim: That's ok! I can look some up. Can you tell me what spices you used in the soup?
[D10:8] John: I added some sage for a nice flavor. Enjoy!
[D10:9] Tim: Thanks! Excited to try this. Love experimenting with spices. By the way, have you been to Universal Studios? Planning a trip there next month.
[D10:10] John: Cool! Haven't been there yet, but I've heard great things about Universal Studios. It's definitely on my bucket list. Have you been before?
[D10:11] Tim: Nope, but it's my first time going. I'm super stoked for the Harry Potter stuff. Can't wait!
[D10:12] John: Cool! It's gonna be a blast, like stepping into another world. Have a great time!
[D10:13] Tim: Thanks! I'll definitely have a blast. I'll let you know how it goes!
[D10:14] John: Great! Can't wait to hear about it. Have a safe trip!
[D10:15] Tim: Thanks! I'll make sure to have a safe trip.
[D10:16] John: Bye! Take care and let's catch up soon!
[D10:17] Tim: Take care! Can't wait to catch up. Talk soon!
[D11:1] John: Hey Tim, been a while! How ya been?
[D11:2] Tim: Hey John! Great to hear from you. Been busy with things, how about you?
[D11:3] John: Yeah, something cool happened! I attended a local restaurant with some new teammates last week. It was great getting to know them better.
[D11:4] Tim: Good support is essential. How do you feel about them?
[D11:5] John: They're great friends. We connected over our shared love for basketball and had a ton of fun.
[D11:6] Tim: Sounds awesome. Having friends who share your hobbies can be really fun. Any exciting plans with them?
[D11:7] John: We're planning to take a team trip next month to explore a new city and have some fun. Can't wait!
[D11:8] Tim: That sounds great! Exploring new cities is always so much fun. Where are you headed?
[D11:9] John: We're still deciding on the destination. Do you have any suggestions?
[D11:10] Tim: Edinburgh, Scotland would be great for a magical vibe. It's the birthplace of Harry Potter and has awesome history and architecture. Plus, it's a beautiful city. What do you think?
[D11:11] John: That sounds like a great idea! I haven't been to Edinburgh yet, but it definitely sounds like a place worth considering for our trip. Thanks for the suggestion!
[D11:12] Tim: Glad you liked it. Let me know if you need any more suggestions.
[D11:13] John: Thanks! I'll definitely reach out if I need more suggestions. Appreciate the help! Here's a pic I snapped during one of our practices. The sunset looked amazing on the court. Moments like these make me so grateful for my basketball career.
[D11:14] Tim: Wow, that looks amazing! What do you love most about your basketball career?
[D11:15] John: Thanks! I love playing pro ball - it's a constant challenge and keeps me growing. There's nothing like seeing myself get better and beating goals. Plus, playing with my teammates and having the fans cheer is awesome. Basketball gives me a great sense of satisfaction and purpose.
[D11:16] Tim: It's great that you have a passion that helps you grow and reach your goals. Achieving and feeling fulfilled must be amazing. Do you have any specific targets or goals you're working towards?
[D11:17] John: Definitely! I'm focusing on better shooting and making more of an impact on the court. I want to be known as a consistent performer and help my team. Off the court, I'm also looking into more endorsements and building my brand. It's important for me to think about life after basketball.
[D11:18] Tim: Awesome! It's great that you have goals both on and off the court. It's wise to think about the future and building your brand. What are your thoughts on life after basketball?
[D11:19] John: I've thought about it a lot. I want to use my platform to make a positive difference and inspire others - maybe even start a foundation and do charity work. It's important to me to make the most of the chances I get and leave a meaningful legacy.
[D11:20] Tim: Wow, that's amazing. Good on you for wanting to make a difference and motivate others. I'm sure you'll succeed! Is there anything I can do to support you?
[D11:21] John: Thanks! I'm trying to figure out how to pick the right ones - any advice on that?
[D11:22] Tim: When picking endorsements, make sure they align with your values and brand. Look for a company that shares your desire to make a change and help others. It's important that the endorsement feels authentic to your followers.
[D11:23] John: Sounds like good advice! I was wondering if you have any book recommendations for my trip?
[D11:24] Tim: Yeah! I think you'd love this fantasy novel by Patrick Rothfuss. It's a book that'll take you to a different world. Great for you when you're traveling. Have fun!
[D11:25] John: Thanks! I'll definitely check it out - looks like a great book to read while traveling. Can't wait to dive into it! Here's a photo of my bookshelf. You can see some of the books I've read and enjoyed.
[D11:26] Tim: Great bookshelf! I saw that you had "The Alchemist" on there, one of my favorites. Did you enjoy it?
[D11:27] John: Yep, I read that book and loved it! It made me think about life and how important it is to follow one's dreams. Highly recommend it!
[D11:28] Tim: Glad you liked it! "The Alchemist" is worth it.
[D11:29] John: Thanks! Take care!
[D11:30] Tim: Have fun! Take care and talk to you soon.
[D12:1] Tim: Hey John! Awesome catchin' up with you! A lot's changed since last time.
[D12:2] John: Hey, Tim! Good to hear from you. Anyway, a lot has been going on with me. My girlfriend and I had an amazing and emotional wedding ceremony last week.
[D12:3] Tim: Congrats! That was such a special day! How did you manage to have the ceremony during these times?
[D12:4] John: Thanks! We were lucky to find a lovely greenhouse venue for a smaller, more intimate gathering. We made sure to follow the necessary safety protocols and ensure that everyone felt safe. It was wonderful to have our loved ones celebrate with us.
[D12:5] Tim: Awesome! It sounds like you found a great venue and had your loved ones celebrate with you. Weddings are definitely full of joy!
[D12:6] John: Yeah! Such a great day! It was so beautiful having everyone celebrating with us. I'd never felt so much love and happiness before. Some of my hiking club friends came even though I just joined!
[D12:7] Tim: Wow! Your wedding day must've been so special. Love sure does bring us joy, huh? Any favorite memories from the big day?
[D12:8] John: Oh yeah! Picking a favorite memory was tough, but seeing her walking down the aisle, her face lit up and it got me all choked up. What a magical moment - one I'll always remember.
[D12:9] Tim: I bet that moment was unreal! One moment can make such an impression. I saw your photo of you two dancing, it must have been incredible. Wanna tell me more?
[D12:10] John: That dance was great! We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight. We were so lucky to have everyone with us!
[D12:11] Tim: Wow, a candlelit dance in a cozy restaurant! Sounds like a fairytale! So special to share with your loved ones. Weddings truly are the best!
[D12:12] John: Thanks! It was a great day. Having everyone there made it extra special. It's moments like these that bring love and joy.
[D12:13] Tim: Congrats again! Love is truly magical and brings so much joy. I'm so happy for you and your new wife!
[D12:14] John: Thanks so much! Your words mean a lot. I'm lucky to have you in my life, bringing so much love and joy.
[D12:15] Tim: Thanks. Your friendship means a lot to me. I'm here for you anytime. I also wanted to share this bookshelf with you. It's filled with my favorite fantasy novels.
[D12:16] John: Cool! What do you enjoy about them so much?
[D12:17] Tim: They really fire up my imagination and take me to alternate realities. They're my escape from reality.
[D12:18] John: That's great Tim! Books and movies make us escape to different places. I like to collect jerseys.
[D12:19] Tim: Cool! Who's your favorite basketball team/player?
[D12:20] John: Thanks! The Wolves are my team for sure. And LeBron is the man - love his skills and leadership.
[D12:21] Tim: The Wolves are solid and LeBron's skills and leadership are amazing.
[D12:22] John: I really admire his work ethic and dedication to the game, such an inspiration.
[D12:23] Tim: LeBron is incredible. Have you ever had the opportunity to meet him or see him play live?
[D12:24] John: Yeah, I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience. I also had the opportunity to see him play live. It was tough, but I learned a lot from watching a top player like him.
[D12:25] Tim: Wow! Meeting him and seeing him play must've been awesome. I can only imagine his skills up close.
[D12:26] John: It was so amazing! The energy was crazy and everyone was so hyped. Seeing the top players was so motivating - it made me want to work even harder. Check out this pic from the game!
[D12:27] Tim: That crowd looks wild! The game must've been amazing!
[D12:28] John: The energy was incredible! It's moments like these that make me love my job.
[D12:29] Tim: Cool! It's great to find something you enjoy doing. Keep going for it! See ya later!
[D13:1] Tim: Hey John! It's been ages since we last talked. Guess what? Last week I went to a Harry Potter conference in the UK - it was incredible! There were so many people who shared the same love of HP as me, it was like a magical family. I felt so inspired and like I got a new lease of life. I love how my passion for fantasy stuff brings me closer to people from all over the world, it's pretty cool.
[D13:2] John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. It's awesome how our passions connect us with others, yeah? You sound like you fit right in and got a real buzz out of it. I feel the same way with my team.
[D13:3] Tim: Wow, you guys look great! How have games been going?
[D13:4] John: It was an intense season with both tough losses and great wins. Overall, I'd say we did pretty well.
[D13:5] Tim: Cool! Sounds like you guys had some tough games. How did you handle those?
[D13:6] John: Thanks! We faced tough opponents but that's what drives us to get better. We back each other up and won't quit.
[D13:7] Tim: Congrats! That's awesome. It must feel good, right?
[D13:8] John: Yeah, it feels great! All that hard work and effort was totally worth it. We even won a trophy!
[D13:9] Tim: Way to go! You must have been elated up there with that trophy. All the hard work paid off! Congrats - I'm so proud of you. Keep it up!
[D13:10] John: Thanks! I was definitely elated. Your support really means a lot to me. I'll keep working hard.
[D13:11] Tim: No problem! I'm here for you anytime. Keep believing in yourself!
[D13:12] John: Thanks! Appreciate your support. Always staying filled with self-belief.
[D13:13] Tim: You got this! Stay motivated and remember that anything is possible with hard work. Keep pushing for your goals!
[D13:14] John: Thanks! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'm feeling motivated and ready to keep pushing for my goals! I'm going to need some new shoes after all these games though.
[D13:15] Tim: Glad my encouragement helped! These are amazing - like walking on clouds! Game changer!
[D13:16] John: They look comfortable. Where did you get them?
[D13:17] Tim: I got them online - they're super comfy! Definitely recommend!
[D13:18] John: Cheers! I'll definitely check them out. Thanks for the recommendation!
[D13:19] Tim: No worries. Let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with. Always here to help!
[D13:20] John: Thanks! Appreciate it. I'll reach out if I need anything.
[D13:21] Tim: Cool! Stay motivated and keep chasing those dreams! Chat soon!
[D13:22] John: Thanks! I'll definitely stay motivated and keep chasing those dreams. You too, keep up the passion. Talk soon!
[D14:1] John: Hey Tim! Long time no talk - a lot has been going on since then!
[D14:2] Tim: Hey John! Long time no see! Can't wait to catch up and hear all about what you've been up to.
[D14:3] John: Seems like forever since we caught up! I'm now mentoring the younger players on my team. It's super rewarding and I'm loving sharing my skills and knowledge with them. It's also a great way for me to stay involved in the game during the off-season.
[D14:4] Tim: Wow! Mentoring must be so rewarding. You get to show others what you know - that's awesome! Is it difficult? Any hiccups?

[D14:6] Tim: Wow, that's awesome! It must be really rewarding to see them reach their goals. What's it like mentoring them?
[D14:7] John: Mentoring them has been awesome! Seeing their growth, improvement, and confidence is so fulfilling. I'm glad I could make a positive impact on their lives. Here's a pic of me and some of the younger players at a recent practice.
[D14:8] Tim: You're really doing great with them. Do any of them see you as a mentor?
[D14:9] John: Some of them do see me as a mentor, which is really rewarding. I try to provide them with advice and support on and off the court. Being a positive role model for them is something I enjoy.
[D14:10] Tim: That's incredible! How does it feel to have their trust and admiration? It must be such an honor to be a positive role model for them.
[D14:11] John: It feels great to have their trust and admiration. Being a role model for these young athletes is so fulfilling. I'm glad my experiences can help shape their future and inspire them to go after their dreams.
[D14:12] Tim: You're doing a great job with them. Way to go! This is what I've been up to.
[D14:13] John: Wow, stunning! And thanks. Really appreciate it. Means a lot.
[D14:14] Tim: I took this pic last summer. Seeing it was so stunning. Thanks for appreciating it. It means a lot to me.
[D14:15] John: Where did you capture this? Nature is truly amazing, isn't it?
[D14:16] Tim: I snapped that pic on my trip to the Smoky Mountains last year. It was incredible seeing it in person. Nature's really something else!
[D14:17] John: Yeah, it's amazing how nature's beauty and grandeur can take our breath away. It's so nice to escape the noise of the city and relax in nature. Good for you to get to enjoy that stunning view!
[D14:18] Tim: Nature is indeed refreshing. A good break from school.
[D14:19] John: How are you doing in shcool?
[D14:20] Tim: Doing good! Busy with studies but finding time to relax with books - good balance.
[D14:21] John: Cool! Finding that balance is key. Are you currently reading any books?
[D14:22] Tim: I'm reading this book and I'm totally hooked! What about you?
[D14:23] John: I haven't had much time to read, but after we talked I finally picked up a book and it's been awesome! Talk to you later!
[D15:1] Tim: Hey John! Haven't talked to you in a bit but wanted to let you know I read this awesome book about castles in the UK. It was so interesting and blew me away! I dream of visiting them one day.
[D15:2] John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. Learning about different cultures and seeing historical architecture fascinates me. Visiting castles is really on my bucket list. [D15:13] Tim: Nice job, John! What did you write on that whiteboard?

[D15:15] Tim: That's awesome! Visual reminders and strategies can really help in staying motivated. It's cool that you have those quotes to keep you going during tough workouts.
[D15:16] John: This plaque I keep on my desk is a constant reminder to believe in myself. It helps me trust my abilities and face any obstacles. Having physical reminders like this really helps me stay motivated.
[D15:17] Tim: That's awesome! What keeps you motivated during challenging times?
[D15:18] John: My teammates believing in me and my love for improving my skills keep me going, even when things get tough. I don't want to let them down.
[D15:19] Tim: Nice one! What do you reckon makes them such a good support?
[D15:20] John: They always support me, even when I make mistakes. Their encouragement keeps me going.
[D15:21] Tim: That's key, having a strong support network can really help with what we're trying to do. Do you have people you can lean on outside of sports?
[D15:22] John: Yeah, I'm lucky - I have people who are super supportive, always there for me no matter what.
