turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Yeah, I saved some but I'm not sure what to do with it - I'm completely content already. I don't have big plans anyway, so it's nice to have the extra cash on hand.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's awesome, Nate! Having some extra cash on hand definitely brings a sense of freedom and relaxation, huh?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yes! Finally, I don't have to stress about it, so I can just enjoy my movies and games.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Taking breaks and reducing stress is pretty nice! Have you watched any good movies recently? I could use some recommendations!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I watched "Little Women" recently, and it was great! The acting was awesome and the story was so captivating. Definitely a good one!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I'm so glad you enjoyed it! I recommended it to you a while back. I watched it too and it really spoke to me. Themes like sisterhood, love, and chasing dreams were explored so well. By the way, I finished up my writing for my book last week. Put in a ton of late nights and edits but finally got it done. I'm so proud of it! Can't wait to see what happens next.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Way to go! We both know it took some effort, but I'm sure it'll be great. Congrats on finishing it up!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Your words mean a lot. Dedication and late nights got me here, but it was worth it. Just like you with your recent tournament - hard work pays off. I appreciate your support throughout!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I'm always here for you, Joanna! You've worked so hard and accomplished a lot – I'm proud. Keep on going!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I won't give up on my goals as long as your here to support me.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You can always count on me! I even made this for you!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, Nate, that looks awesome! What inspired you?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I figured you could always look back on this whenever you need encouragement, and that was all the inspiration I needed. And I would also say that your life path can be quite inspirational!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, Nate! That's sweet of you! I'll make sure to remember this when I need the encouragement the most.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Awesome! I know encouragement is what got me so far in my gameing career, so I figured why not share the love.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Rest assured, it will be something I cherish! On another note, I just finished this cute little bookmark for one of the ladies at my writing club!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That bookmark is great. I'm sure she'll love it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! I absolutley love DIYs, and I know she does too.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Let me know how it goes!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure thing! Bye for now!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, it's been a couple days since we last talked. Something exciting happened last Friday. I went to a game convention and met new people who weren't from my normal circle. It was a bit overwhelming but it reminded me of the good times gaming can bring.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Good to hear from you. Sounds like fun! Meeting new people can be overwhelming, but the rewards can be great. Sometimes it's good to step outside our comfort zones and explore new things.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, you're right! We can have great experiences if we take risks. I even made some friends at the convention who love games just like me. We already planned a gaming session together - it's cool to meet people who have the same interests!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That looks awesome! I'm glad you met people who share your interests - that definitely makes experiences more fun..

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I also met some people who also played this boardgame I love, so I joined in. We had a lot in common and hit it off. It's great when shared hobbies can bond people!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: It's incredible how a game can bring people together and form strong relationships. Did you do anything else there?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: We played this game Catan - it's a great strategy game where you build settlements and trade resources. I love it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Looks cool! Is it more of a competitive game or a more chill one?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It can be both competitive and chill. We were competing, but still had lots of fun.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Competitive games can definitely be difficult to play sometimes when people get all upset about every move you make, but it's cool they were all chill! Glad you had a good time.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It was great! Playing games is my escape from life struggles, so I generally don't get crazy competitive over them. The people at the convention were the same way!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Glad you found a way to have fun and escape! It's important to stay happy and de-stress. Keep doing what makes you happy!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: For sure! You should go to a writing convention or something sometime! The experience at this convention is unforgetable.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Do writing conventions exist? I'll have to look into that, it could be fun! Thanks for the idea. Have you been up to anything tonight?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Mostly just chilling at home. Playing video games or watching movies helps me unwind.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That sounds great! What's your favorite game or movie that you've seen recently?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I recently saw a movie that blew my mind with all the twists and dream stuff, I think it was called "Inception". I've also been playing a game nonstop with a great futuristic setting and gameplay called "Cyberpunk 2077". Have you seen or played anything good lately?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, it's so comfy in there! I should really get a set up like that.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You should! It's one thing to watch a movie in a theater, but on a nice comfy couch with a good blanket, I feel so at peace!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Any pointers on what I should get for my living room to make it comfy like that?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sure! For one, you should get a couch that can sit multiple people so that you can lay down if you want, and make sure its really fluffy! Also invest in a blanket that has a little bit of weight to it, and some lights that can be dimmed.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Sounds like you really got into making your living room! Thanks, I'll try that out for myself!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: No problem! I get super invested in random little things like that, but I think its all worth it when I end up with random little things that make life so much nicer.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks for the tip! See you later!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: See ya Nate!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, what's been up? Haven't seen you since we last talked.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! I have been revising and perfecting the recipe I made for my family and it turned out really tasty. What's been happening with you?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! That's cool. I've been getting so stressed lately because of my tournament progress - tough competitors - but my turtles always cheer me up.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Pets have a way of brightening our days. I still have that stuffed animal dog you gave me! I named her Tilly, and she's always with me while I write.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Glad to hear it! What made you name her Tilly?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I used to have a dog back in Michigan with that name, but then I got allergic and we had to get rid of her. The name helps me remember her back when I used to be able to hold and squeeze animal without an allergic reaction!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's so touching! Glad the stuffed animal means so much!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Tilly helps me stay focused and brings me so much joy. It's amazing how even stuffed animals can do that!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It really is, I'm not sure I'll ever understand why watching my turtles slowly walk around makes me so happy. But I'm very glad it does.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Same here! So have you been up to anything recenly?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, I've just been practicing for my next video game tournemant. How about you?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Well, I had a bit of a setback recently - another rejection from a production company.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Bummer, Joanna. Is this the one you sent to a film contest? Rejections suck, but don't forget they don't define you. Keep at it and you'll find the perfect opportunity.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah.. Thanks, Nate. It's hard, but I won't let it slow me down. I'm gonna keep grinding and moving ahead.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's what I like to hear! I really respect you for that and being able to bounce back whenever something sad happens!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Your encouragement really means a lot. I'm gonna keep pushing forward and believing in myself.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You got this, and don't ever forget that you have people cheering you on from the sidelines wherever you go.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks! I'll see you around!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: No problem! Catch you later!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, what's been up since we last chatted? How's it going?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Another movie script that I contributed to was shown on the big screen last Sunday for the first time! It was such a surreal experience to see everything come together. I felt a mix of emotions, but overall, it was a satisfying moment. I've been waiting for this for a long time!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Congrats Joanna! How was it to finally see it on the big screen? [shares a photo holding a videogame controller]

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: It was an amazing experience! I'll never forget seeing all of the characters and dialogue I wrote being acted out - it was such a cool feeling. Having all the hard work and determination I put into writing pay off was definitely rewarding. I know this is the third time it's happened, but its just so awesome!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That must have been amazing. What was your favorite part of it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Seeing my characters I worked so hard on come alive was my favorite part. It felt like they jumped off the page and became real - it was totally surreal.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow Joanna, those drawings are really incredible! What inspired you to create them?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! They're visuals of the characters to help bring them alive in my head so I can write better.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's a cool way to gain insight into your characters. Where did you get your ideas for them?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I got ideas from everywhere: people I know, stuff I saw, even what I imagined. It's cool to see how an idea takes shape into a person with their own wants, worries, and wishes.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow Joanna, that's so cool! It's amazing how our imaginations can bring ideas to life. Can you tell me more about the character on the left in the photo?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nope! You'll just have to watch the movie and find out for yourself!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You got it. I was already planning on watching it, but talking to you about it makes me want to watch it even more!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! Well enough about me, what have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I was bored today, so I just took my turtles out for a walk.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sound fun! Did they have a good time?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Of course! They look tired from all the walking, so they're relaxing in the tank right now.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Aww, they're so cute! What do they eat?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: They eat a combination of vegetables, fruits, and insects. They have a varied diet.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that's fascinating! It's interesting how they have such a varied diet, including insects. Do you have a favorite among their food choices?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I love seeing them eat fruit - they get so hyped and it's so cute!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that's so cute! They look like they really enjoy fruit.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, it's adorable! Watching them enjoy their favorite snacks is so fun. I also like holding them.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Do they have different personalities, like the way dogs and cats do?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, they each do. One is more adventurous while the other is more reserved, which I find cute. Having them around brings me joy and they make great companions.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That's super cool! I never knew turtles could be so interesting until I met your turtles. Wow!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I've always liked turtles since I was a boy, so I know all about them!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You'll have to keep me posted on them! It's been fun chatting!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: See you later Joanna!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, Nate, I'm on fire! I just set up meetings with movie producers — my dreams are comin' true!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow Joanna, nice work! How did it go with those producer meetings?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! The meetings went really well. I felt confident discussing my script and vision and they seemed interested and excited. They loved the elements of self-discovery in it. It was so validating to be taken seriously. I'm feeling hopeful and inspired about the future!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Way to go, Joanna! Putting yourself out there is really brave and winning recognition for your hard work feels great. It's just like when I win a video game tournament - it feels awesome! I'm so proud of you and so glad you're feeling hopeful and inspired.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot. Writing isn't always easy but moments like these make me appreciate it. I'm so thankful for all the opportunities. Last week, I found these old notebooks with my early writings - it was cool to see how far I've come.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That's cool! You must love seeing how you've grown as an artist. Is there a favorite piece from your early writings that stands out to you?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yup, I still remember this story from when I was 10. It was about a brave little turtle who was scared but explored the world anyway. Maybe even back then, I was inspired by stories about finding courage and taking risks. It's still a part of my writing today.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: You obviously have a passion for writing, and it's funny the story was about a turtle! Their resilience is so inspiring! Take courage and keep pushing yourself with your writing. Great job!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! They make me think of strength and perseverance. They help motivate me in tough times - glad you find that inspiring!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: What can I say, I love turtles. So, what's been happening with you?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Apart from meetings, I'm working on a project - challenging but fulfilling. How about you? What's been going on?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Just been helping some friends reset their high scores at the international tournament. It's been fun!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, sounds like so much fun! You're really passionate about gaming. Have an awesome time and keep helping others with those high scores!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks! It feels good to use my skills to make a difference.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I couldn't agree more! Which is why my meetings are so exciting!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: On another note, want to come over and try some of this? It's super yummy, just made it yesterday!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Mmm, that looks delicious! Is it lactose-free by any chance?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep, I made it with coconut milk so it's lactose-free!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks so much, Nate! Sure! I'll come over tomorrow if that's fine.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I don't see why not! I'm not doing anything then, so your completely welcome to!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Awesome! I'll bring some of my recipes so we can both share deserts!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: I'd love that! I've been wanting to try some of your chocolate and rasberry cake for a while now.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You got it! See you tomorrow!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: See you then! Take care!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna! Hope you’re doing alright. Crazy thing happened - I was in the final of a big Valorant tournament last Saturday, and I won! It was the best feeling to see my name as the champion. Tournaments really bring out strong emotions in me.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate! Congrats on winning the tournament - that's awesome! I know you must have been buzzing! Anyway, I've been working on something exciting too. Last Friday, I finished the presentation for producers - it was tough but it's looking good. What have you been up to?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I've been having a blast and preparing for other tournaments, so I've been real busy - but I'm loving it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds like you're really loving life right now! It's great when you find something that suits you. Being busy can be tiring but it's so rewarding in the end. Keep it up!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I'm really grateful to have a job I enjoy every day. So anyways, anything new going on in your life?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: I am writing another movie script! It's a love story with lots of challenges. I've put lots of hard work into it and I'm hoping to get it on the big screen.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Woah Joanna, that's incredible! I remember when you started working on these sorta things. It's crazy to see how far you've gotten! You've really got a thing for writing, huh? Where'd you get the idea for it?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks Nate! Writing has always been a passion of mine. I got the idea for this script from a dream. How have your turtles been? I haven't seen pictures of them in a while!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Great actually! These little guys sure bring joy to my life! Watching them is so calming and fascinating. I've really grown fond of them. So, what about you, Joanna? What brings you happiness?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Creating stories and watching them come alive gives me happiness and fulfillment. Writing has been such a blessing for me.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Well with dedication like yours, its no wonder you do so well in it as well! Are you planning on submitting anymore scripts anytime soon?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yep! I actually just submitted a few more last week! Hoping to hear back from them soon, though I assume a few will be rejected.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Even if it happens to a few, I'm sure at leasts one will make it to the screens and be your 3rd published movie!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! Appreciate the encouragement. I won't give up, I promise! Got it covered!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Great to hear! On another note, I just upgraded some of my equipment at home. Check it out!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Oh wow, ice set-up! Do you use that computer for gaming?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep! This is where I practice and compete. Sometimes I even use it when I'm playing games with friends.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Cool! Having a dedicated space for practice and competition should help you stay focused.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah, I love it. It's like my own little haven to escape into the virtual world.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that sounds great to have your own gaming setup at home. It must be really awesome!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: It really is! But it's also really important to have something like this for my career, otherwise I would never be able to beat my competition.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That makes sense! It's all about practice isn't it? So what's your favorite game?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yep! I'm currently playing this awesome fantasy RPG called "Xeonoblade Chronicles" and it's been a blast! I highly reccomend it if you've never played it before.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: What made you start playing it? That's a japanese game series right?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yes it is! I'm a big fan of Nintendo games, and I've actually been wanting to play this one for a while because my friends have played it and reccomended it!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Nice! It's really cool when a reccomendation from a friend fits your taste so well isn't it?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: For sure! That's why I love when you give me movie reccomendations, I usually like them a lot more then if I were to just watch some random one.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Great to hear! I just finished with the intro to my next movie script, and I decided to include this at the begining.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That letter is really awesome! Does it remind you of your childhood?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yeah, it does! My brother wrote it - he used to make me these cute notes when we were kids. Brings back sweet memories.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Aww, childhood memories can be so powerful!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: They sure can! They take us back to simpler times but it's nice to create new memories as we grow up.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Totally! I had a special day when I took my pets to the park. They were amazed and seeing their happy faces made it a memorable day. Mixing the new with the old is priceless - I treasure every memory!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: That sounds so sweet, Nate! I started writing some of my favorite memories down.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Dang, your full of great ideas Joanna! I really should start doing that as well, or at least write down the things my animals like a lot!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: You should! I completely encourage it, looking back on fond memories is such a blessing.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Ok I will! But I'll also start writing down some of my favorite memories with you from now on.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Definitely, let's keep making great memories and supporting each other. Let's keep reaching for our dreams and make them happen!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, what a wild week! My game tournament got pushed back, so I tried out some cooking. Look at this homemade coconut ice cream! The sprinkles kinda changed the color this time around.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, that looks yummy! Wish I could try it, but I can't right now. How did the last game tournament go?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, thanks! Tough tournament, didn't make it to the finals. But that's okay, I'll get 'em next time!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Aww, bummer! But the important thing is to stay positive. So, what's your next move in the gaming world?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Staying positive is key. I'm thinking of joining a new gaming team after this next tourney - I've had a few offers, but I haven't decided yet. It's gonna be a big step, but I'm ready for a shake up.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Sounds great, Nate! Making a switch could open up new opportunities. Wishing you luck with picking the right team!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks, Joanna! I really appreciate it. It's a big decision, but I'm excited for what the future holds. How about you? Anything exciting happening on your end?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Yup! I worked hard on another script and eventually created a plan for getting it made into a movie. It was a ton of work but satisfying. I pitched it to some producers yesterday and they really liked it. It gave me a big confidence boost!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Congrats on the chance to pitch your script - super impressive. Proud of you!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Appreciate you, Nate! Your support and encouragement mean a lot to me. I feel like I just can't stop writing write now!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Anytime. What're you working on in that notebook? Anything cool?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Hey Nate, I'm working on a new project - a suspenseful thriller set in a small Midwestern town. It's been a great creative outlet for me. How about you? Do you have any projects you're working on?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Yeah actually - creating gaming content for YouTube. It's a cool way to entertain folks and satisfy my video game cravings at the same time when there aren't any tourneys going on.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, that's a cool idea! What inspired you to start making gaming videos?

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Hey Joanna, I'm a big fan of them and thought it would be a fun idea to start making them myself. I'm hoping to share my love of gaming and connect with others who enjoy it too.

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Way to go, Nate! Making videos and connecting with people about gaming - that's awesome! You'll do great!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Thanks Joanna! Appreciate the support. It's new to me but I'm excited to get started!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Make sure you watch other peoples videos first so you get a handle on what your audience likes! That way your videos don't flop when you post them.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Already doing that, but thanks for the advice!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: No worries, Nate! It's great to support each other in reaching our goals. On another note, check out this pic I got a while back!

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: Wow, that sunset pic looks incredible! What inspired you to take that photo?

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Thanks, Nate! I took that pic on a hike last summer near Fort Wayne. The sunset and the surrounding beauty were just incredible. It was an awesome reminder of nature's beauty.

turns.speaker: Nate
turns.text: That sounds incredible! Nature truly has a way of reminding us to appreciate the beauty around us, and moments like those really stay with you. These critters also make me appreciate life's little joys. And guess what? I got them a new friend!

turns.speaker: Joanna
turns.text: Wow, what made you get a third?

[D21:13] Joanna: Hey Nate, I love making this dairy-free chocolate cake with raspberries. It's so moist and delicious - perfect sweetness level.
[D21:14] Nate: That cake looks amazing, Joanna! How did you make it?
[D21:15] Joanna: I make it with almond flour, coconut oil, chocolate and raspberries. It's my favorite for birthdays and special days.
[D21:16] Nate: Yum, Joanna! Gotta try that one. Any others you want to share?
[D21:17] Joanna: Hey Nate! Here's another recipe I like. It's a delicious dessert made with blueberries, coconut milk, and a gluten-free crust. So creamy and delicious!
[D21:18] Nate: Wow, Joanna! That dessert looks amazing. I'll definitely have to give it a try. Thanks!
[D21:19] Joanna: Glad to help, Nate. Let me know if you try it. I'm sure you'll enjoy it. It was great chatting.
[D21:20] Nate: Thanks Joanna! I will. Bye!
[D22:1] Joanna: Hey Nate, hi! Yesterday, I tried my newest dairy-free recipe and it was a winner with my family! Mixing and matching flavors is fun and I'm always trying new things. How about you?
[D22:2] Nate: Hey Joanna! That tart looks yummy! Lately, I've been doing great - I won a really big video game tournament last week and it was awesome! I still can't believe I made so much money from it.
[D22:3] Joanna: Way to go, Nate! Winning the tournament and earning cash is awesome - congrats! Did you save it for something special?
[D22:4] Nate: Thanks Joanna! Yeah, I saved some but I'm not sure what to do with it - I'm completely content already. I don't have big plans anyway, so it's nice to have the extra cash on hand.
[D22:5] Joanna: That's awesome, Nate! Having some extra cash on hand definitely brings a sense of freedom and relaxation, huh?
[D22:6] Nate: Yes! Finally, I don't have to stress about it, so I can just enjoy my movies and games.
[D22:7] Joanna: Taking breaks and reducing stress is pretty nice! Have you watched any good movies recently? I could use some recommendations!
[D22:8] Nate: I watched "Little Women" recently, and it was great! The acting was awesome and the story was so captivating. Definitely a good one!
[D22:9] Joanna: I'm so glad you enjoyed it! I recommended it to you a while back. I watched it too and it really spoke to me. Themes like sisterhood, love, and chasing dreams were explored so well. By the way, I finished up my writing for my book last week. Put in a ton of late nights and edits but finally got it done. I'm so proud of it! Can't wait to see what happens next.
[D22:10] Nate: Way to go! We both know it took some effort, but I'm sure it'll be great. Congrats on finishing it up!
[D22:11] Joanna: Thanks Nate! Your words mean a lot. Dedication and late nights got me here, but it was worth it. Just like you with your recent tournament - hard work pays off. I appreciate your support throughout!
[D22:12] Nate: I'm always here for you, Joanna! You've worked so hard and accomplished a lot – I'm proud. Keep on going!
[D22:13] Joanna: Thanks, Nate! I won't give up on my goals as long as your here to support me.
[D22:14] Nate: You can always count on me! I even made this for you!
[D22:15] Joanna: Wow, Nate, that looks awesome! What inspired you?
[D22:16] Nate: I figured you could always look back on this whenever you need encouragement, and that was all the inspiration I needed. And I would also say that your life path can be quite inspirational!
[D22:17] Joanna: Wow, Nate! That's sweet of you! I'll make sure to remember this when I need the encouragement the most.
[D22:18] Nate: Awesome! I know encouragement is what got me so far in my gameing career, so I figured why not share the love.
[D22:19] Joanna: Rest assured, it will be something I cherish! On another note, I just finished this cute little bookmark for one of the ladies at my writing club!
[D22:20] Nate: That bookmark is great. I'm sure she'll love it!
[D22:21] Joanna: Thanks Nate! I absolutley love DIYs, and I know she does too.
[D22:22] Nate: Let me know how it goes!
[D22:23] Joanna: Sure thing! Bye for now!
[D23:1] Nate: Hey Joanna, it's been a couple days since we last talked. Something exciting happened last Friday. I went to a game convention and met new people who weren't from my normal circle. It was a bit overwhelming but it reminded me of the good times gaming can bring.
[D23:2] Joanna: Hey Nate! Good to hear from you. Sounds like fun! Meeting new people can be overwhelming, but the rewards can be great. Sometimes it's good to step outside our comfort zones and explore new things.
[D23:3] Nate: Yeah, you're right! We can have great experiences if we take risks. I even made some friends at the convention who love games just like me. We already planned a gaming session together - it's cool to meet people who have the same interests!
[D23:4] Joanna: That looks awesome! I'm glad you met people who share your interests - that definitely makes experiences more fun..
[D23:5] Nate: I also met some people who also played this boardgame I love, so I joined in. We had a lot in common and hit it off. It's great when shared hobbies can bond people!
[D23:6] Joanna: It's incredible how a game can bring people together and form strong relationships. Did you do anything else there?
[D23:7] Nate: We played this game Catan - it's a great strategy game where you build settlements and trade resources. I love it!
[D23:8] Joanna: Looks cool! Is it more of a competitive game or a more chill one?
[D23:9] Nate: It can be both competitive and chill. We were competing, but still had lots of fun.
[D23:10] Joanna: Competitive games can definitely be difficult to play sometimes when people get all upset about every move you make, but it's cool they were all chill! Glad you had a good time.
[D23:11] Nate: It was great! Playing games is my escape from life struggles, so I generally don't get crazy competitive over them. The people at the convention were the same way!
[D23:12] Joanna: Glad you found a way to have fun and escape! It's important to stay happy and de-stress. Keep doing what makes you happy!
[D23:13] Nate: For sure! You should go to a writing convention or something sometime! The experience at this convention is unforgetable.
[D23:14] Joanna: Do writing conventions exist? I'll have to look into that, it could be fun! Thanks for the idea. Have you been up to anything tonight?
[D23:15] Nate: Mostly just chilling at home. Playing video games or watching movies helps me unwind.
[D23:16] Joanna: That sounds great! What's your favorite game or movie that you've seen recently?
[D23:17] Nate: I recently saw a movie that blew my mind with all the twists and dream stuff, I think it was called "Inception". I've also been playing a game nonstop with a great futuristic setting and gameplay called "Cyberpunk 2077". Have you seen or played anything good lately?
[D23:18] Joanna: I watched a classic movie the other day that was awesome - the story was so gripping and the actors were great! It really stuck with me.
[D23:19] Nate: Wow, that must have been awesome! What would you rate it?
[D23:20] Joanna: Well, it was amazing, so probably 9 or 10 out of 10! Movies can take us to different places and make us feel lots of emotions. What do you love about watching them?
[D23:21] Nate: Well they take me to new worlds and fill me with emotions. Plus, they're great for chilling out after a day.
[D23:22] Joanna: I agree! They have the power to take us away and make us feel things not normally experienced in life. It's a great escape! Especially when you have a room like this!

[D9:2] John: Hey Tim! I know the stress of exams and homework, but you got this! I'm doing OK, cheers for asking. Last week I visited home and caught up with my family and old friends. We had a great time talking about our childhood - it reminds me of the good ol' times!
[D9:3] Tim: Thanks for the pic! That group looks like a great squad. How long did you all play together?
[D9:4] John: We were teammates for four years in high school, so we've played together for quite some time. Have you ever been part of a sports team?
[D9:5] Tim: Nope, never been on a sports team. I'm more into reading and fantasy novels. I love sinking into different magical worlds. It's one of the reasons I love traveling to new places, to experience a different kind of magic.
[D9:6] John: Wow, Tim, that's an awesome book collection! It's cool to escape to different worlds with a hobby. By the way, I love discovering new cities - check out this pic from one of my trips to New York City!
[D9:7] Tim: Wow! That skyline looks amazing - I've been wanting to visit NYC. How was it?
[D9:8] John: Thanks! It was amazing. Everywhere you go there's something new and exciting. Exploring the city and trying all the restaurants was awesome. It's a must-visit!
[D9:9] Tim: Adding NYC to my travel list, sounds like a great adventure! I heard there's so much to explore and try out. Can't wait to visit!
[D9:10] John: Trust me, NYC is amazing! It's got so much to check out - the culture, food - you won't regret it. It's an adventure you'll never forget!
[D9:11] Tim: Woohoo! Sounds like a fun place with lots of potential. Can't wait to experience it for myself!
[D9:12] John: Awesome! Can't wait to hear when you are going. Let me know and I'm sure I can help you out.
[D9:13] Tim: Yep, I'll let you know! Thanks for being so helpful.
[D9:14] John: Sure thing! Any time you need help, don't hesitate to reach out.
[D9:15] Tim: Thanks! Your support means a lot to me. Bye!
[D10:1] Tim: Hey John, it's been a few days! I got a no for a summer job I wanted which wasn't great but I'm staying positive. On your NYC trip, did you have any troubles? How did you handle them?
[D10:2] John: Hey Tim! Sorry to hear about the job, but your positivity will help you find something great! My trip went okay - I had some trouble figuring out the subway at first, but then it was easy after someone helped explain it. How about you? Anything new you've tackled?
[D10:3] Tim: Thanks! Appreciate your encouragement. Yesterday, I tackled something new - I gave a presentation in class. I was nervous but I made it. Small step, but feels like progress.
[D10:4] John: Cool, Tim! Taking the plunge and presenting can be tough, but awesome work! Progress is progress, keep it up. By the way, I've been trying out cooking recipes. Made this tasty soup recently - it was real good!
[D10:5] Tim: Wow, that looks great! How did you make it? Do you have a recipe you can share?
[D10:6] John: Thanks, I just sort of made it up on the spot so I don't have a recipe.
[D10:7] Tim: That's ok! I can look some up. Can you tell me what spices you used in the soup?
[D10:8] John: I added some sage for a nice flavor. Enjoy!
[D10:9] Tim: Thanks! Excited to try this. Love experimenting with spices. By the way, have you been to Universal Studios? Planning a trip there next month.
[D10:10] John: Cool! Haven't been there yet, but I've heard great things about Universal Studios. It's definitely on my bucket list. Have you been before?
[D10:11] Tim: Nope, but it's my first time going. I'm super stoked for the Harry Potter stuff. Can't wait!
[D10:12] John: Cool! It's gonna be a blast, like stepping into another world. Have a great time!
[D10:13] Tim: Thanks! I'll definitely have a blast. I'll let you know how it goes!
[D10:14] John: Great! Can't wait to hear about it. Have a safe trip!
[D10:15] Tim: Thanks! I'll make sure to have a safe trip.
[D10:16] John: Bye! Take care and let's catch up soon!
[D10:17] Tim: Take care! Can't wait to catch up. Talk soon!
[D11:1] John: Hey Tim, been a while! How ya been?
[D11:2] Tim: Hey John! Great to hear from you. Been busy with things, how about you?
[D11:3] John: Yeah, something cool happened! I attended a local restaurant with some new teammates last week. It was great getting to know them better.
[D11:4] Tim: Good support is essential. How do you feel about them?
[D11:5] John: They're great friends. We connected over our shared love for basketball and had a ton of fun.
[D11:6] Tim: Sounds awesome. Having friends who share your hobbies can be really fun. Any exciting plans with them?
[D11:7] John: We're planning to take a team trip next month to explore a new city and have some fun. Can't wait!
[D11:8] Tim: That sounds great! Exploring new cities is always so much fun. Where are you headed?
[D11:9] John: We're still deciding on the destination. Do you have any suggestions?
[D11:10] Tim: Edinburgh, Scotland would be great for a magical vibe. It's the birthplace of Harry Potter and has awesome history and architecture. Plus, it's a beautiful city. What do you think?
[D11:11] John: That sounds like a great idea! I haven't been to Edinburgh yet, but it definitely sounds like a place worth considering for our trip. Thanks for the suggestion!
[D11:12] Tim: Glad you liked it. Let me know if you need any more suggestions.
[D11:13] John: Thanks! I'll definitely reach out if I need more suggestions. Appreciate the help! Here's a pic I snapped during one of our practices. The sunset looked amazing on the court. Moments like these make me so grateful for my basketball career.
[D11:14] Tim: Wow, that looks amazing! What do you love most about your basketball career?
[D11:15] John: Thanks! I love playing pro ball - it's a constant challenge and keeps me growing. There's nothing like seeing myself get better and beating goals. Plus, playing with my teammates and having the fans cheer is awesome. Basketball gives me a great sense of satisfaction and purpose.
[D11:16] Tim: It's great that you have a passion that helps you grow and reach your goals. Achieving and feeling fulfilled must be amazing. Do you have any specific targets or goals you're working towards?
[D11:17] John: Definitely! I'm focusing on better shooting and making more of an impact on the court. I want to be known as a consistent performer and help my team. Off the court, I'm also looking into more endorsements and building my brand. It's important for me to think about life after basketball.
[D11:18] Tim: Awesome! It's great that you have goals both on and off the court. It's wise to think about the future and building your brand. What are your thoughts on life after basketball?
[D11:19] John: I've thought about it a lot. I want to use my platform to make a positive difference and inspire others - maybe even start a foundation and do charity work. It's important to me to make the most of the chances I get and leave a meaningful legacy.
[D11:20] Tim: Wow, that's amazing. Good on you for wanting to make a difference and motivate others. I'm sure you'll succeed! Is there anything I can do to support you?
[D11:21] John: Thanks! I'm trying to figure out how to pick the right ones - any advice on that?
[D11:22] Tim: When picking endorsements, make sure they align with your values and brand. Look for a company that shares your desire to make a change and help others. It's important that the endorsement feels authentic to your followers.
[D11:23] John: Sounds like good advice! I was wondering if you have any book recommendations for my trip?
[D11:24] Tim: Yeah! I think you'd love this fantasy novel by Patrick Rothfuss. It's a book that'll take you to a different world. Great for you when you're traveling. Have fun!
[D11:25] John: Thanks! I'll definitely check it out - looks like a great book to read while traveling. Can't wait to dive into it! Here's a photo of my bookshelf. You can see some of the books I've read and enjoyed.
[D11:26] Tim: Great bookshelf! I saw that you had "The Alchemist" on there, one of my favorites. Did you enjoy it?
[D11:27] John: Yep, I read that book and loved it! It made me think about life and how important it is to follow one's dreams. Highly recommend it!
[D11:28] Tim: Glad you liked it! "The Alchemist" is worth it.
[D11:29] John: Thanks! Take care!
[D11:30] Tim: Have fun! Take care and talk to you soon.
[D12:1] Tim: Hey John! Awesome catchin' up with you! A lot's changed since last time.
[D12:2] John: Hey, Tim! Good to hear from you. Anyway, a lot has been going on with me. My girlfriend and I had an amazing and emotional wedding ceremony last week.
[D12:3] Tim: Congrats! That was such a special day! How did you manage to have the ceremony during these times?
[D12:4] John: Thanks! We were lucky to find a lovely greenhouse venue for a smaller, more intimate gathering. We made sure to follow the necessary safety protocols and ensure that everyone felt safe. It was wonderful to have our loved ones celebrate with us.
[D12:5] Tim: Awesome! It sounds like you found a great venue and had your loved ones celebrate with you. Weddings are definitely full of joy!
[D12:6] John: Yeah! Such a great day! It was so beautiful having everyone celebrating with us. I'd never felt so much love and happiness before. Some of my hiking club friends came even though I just joined!
[D12:7] Tim: Wow! Your wedding day must've been so special. Love sure does bring us joy, huh? Any favorite memories from the big day?
[D12:8] John: Oh yeah! Picking a favorite memory was tough, but seeing her walking down the aisle, her face lit up and it got me all choked up. What a magical moment - one I'll always remember.
[D12:9] Tim: I bet that moment was unreal! One moment can make such an impression. I saw your photo of you two dancing, it must have been incredible. Wanna tell me more?
[D12:10] John: That dance was great! We had our first dance at a cozy restaurant. It was so dreamy with the music and candlelight. We were so lucky to have everyone with us!
[D12:11] Tim: Wow, a candlelit dance in a cozy restaurant! Sounds like a fairytale! So special to share with your loved ones. Weddings truly are the best!
[D12:12] John: Thanks! It was a great day. Having everyone there made it extra special. It's moments like these that bring love and joy.
[D12:13] Tim: Congrats again! Love is truly magical and brings so much joy. I'm so happy for you and your new wife!
[D12:14] John: Thanks so much! Your words mean a lot. I'm lucky to have you in my life, bringing so much love and joy.
[D12:15] Tim: Thanks. Your friendship means a lot to me. I'm here for you anytime. I also wanted to share this bookshelf with you. It's filled with my favorite fantasy novels.
[D12:16] John: Cool! What do you enjoy about them so much?
[D12:17] Tim: They really fire up my imagination and take me to alternate realities. They're my escape from reality.
[D12:18] John: That's great Tim! Books and movies make us escape to different places. I like to collect jerseys.
[D12:19] Tim: Cool! Who's your favorite basketball team/player?
[D12:20] John: Thanks! The Wolves are my team for sure. And LeBron is the man - love his skills and leadership.
[D12:21] Tim: The Wolves are solid and LeBron's skills and leadership are amazing.
[D12:22] John: I really admire his work ethic and dedication to the game, such an inspiration.
[D12:23] Tim: LeBron is incredible. Have you ever had the opportunity to meet him or see him play live?
[D12:24] John: Yeah, I've had the chance to meet him a few times. He's real chill and it was a wild experience. I also had the opportunity to see him play live. It was tough, but I learned a lot from watching a top player like him.
[D12:25] Tim: Wow! Meeting him and seeing him play must've been awesome. I can only imagine his skills up close.
[D12:26] John: It was so amazing! The energy was crazy and everyone was so hyped. Seeing the top players was so motivating - it made me want to work even harder. Check out this pic from the game!
[D12:27] Tim: That crowd looks wild! The game must've been amazing!
[D12:28] John: The energy was incredible! It's moments like these that make me love my job.
[D12:29] Tim: Cool! It's great to find something you enjoy doing. Keep going for it! See ya later!
[D13:1] Tim: Hey John! It's been ages since we last talked. Guess what? Last week I went to a Harry Potter conference in the UK - it was incredible! There were so many people who shared the same love of HP as me, it was like a magical family. I felt so inspired and like I got a new lease of life. I love how my passion for fantasy stuff brings me closer to people from all over the world, it's pretty cool.
[D13:2] John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. It's awesome how our passions connect us with others, yeah? You sound like you fit right in and got a real buzz out of it. I feel the same way with my team.

[D13:4] John: It was an intense season with both tough losses and great wins. Overall, I'd say we did pretty well.
[D13:5] Tim: Cool! Sounds like you guys had some tough games. How did you handle those?
[D13:6] John: Thanks! We faced tough opponents but that's what drives us to get better. We back each other up and won't quit.
[D13:7] Tim: Congrats! That's awesome. It must feel good, right?
[D13:8] John: Yeah, it feels great! All that hard work and effort was totally worth it. We even won a trophy!
[D13:9] Tim: Way to go! You must have been elated up there with that trophy. All the hard work paid off! Congrats - I'm so proud of you. Keep it up!
[D13:10] John: Thanks! I was definitely elated. Your support really means a lot to me. I'll keep working hard.
[D13:11] Tim: No problem! I'm here for you anytime. Keep believing in yourself!
[D13:12] John: Thanks! Appreciate your support. Always staying filled with self-belief.
[D13:13] Tim: You got this! Stay motivated and remember that anything is possible with hard work. Keep pushing for your goals!
[D13:14] John: Thanks! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'm feeling motivated and ready to keep pushing for my goals! I'm going to need some new shoes after all these games though.
[D13:15] Tim: Glad my encouragement helped! These are amazing - like walking on clouds! Game changer!
[D13:16] John: They look comfortable. Where did you get them?
[D13:17] Tim: I got them online - they're super comfy! Definitely recommend!
[D13:18] John: Cheers! I'll definitely check them out. Thanks for the recommendation!
[D13:19] Tim: No worries. Let me know if there's anything else I can assist you with. Always here to help!
[D13:20] John: Thanks! Appreciate it. I'll reach out if I need anything.
[D13:21] Tim: Cool! Stay motivated and keep chasing those dreams! Chat soon!
[D13:22] John: Thanks! I'll definitely stay motivated and keep chasing those dreams. You too, keep up the passion. Talk soon!
[D14:1] John: Hey Tim! Long time no talk - a lot has been going on since then!
[D14:2] Tim: Hey John! Long time no see! Can't wait to catch up and hear all about what you've been up to.
[D14:3] John: Seems like forever since we caught up! I'm now mentoring the younger players on my team. It's super rewarding and I'm loving sharing my skills and knowledge with them. It's also a great way for me to stay involved in the game during the off-season.
[D14:4] Tim: Wow! Mentoring must be so rewarding. You get to show others what you know - that's awesome! Is it difficult? Any hiccups?
[D14:5] John: There are challenges, since everyone is so different. But it's been awesome gaining experience and adapting, motivating and encouraging everyone. It's been great to watch each of them develop and reach their goals - such a reward!
[D14:6] Tim: Wow, that's awesome! It must be really rewarding to see them reach their goals. What's it like mentoring them?
[D14:7] John: Mentoring them has been awesome! Seeing their growth, improvement, and confidence is so fulfilling. I'm glad I could make a positive impact on their lives. Here's a pic of me and some of the younger players at a recent practice.
[D14:8] Tim: You're really doing great with them. Do any of them see you as a mentor?
[D14:9] John: Some of them do see me as a mentor, which is really rewarding. I try to provide them with advice and support on and off the court. Being a positive role model for them is something I enjoy.
[D14:10] Tim: That's incredible! How does it feel to have their trust and admiration? It must be such an honor to be a positive role model for them.
[D14:11] John: It feels great to have their trust and admiration. Being a role model for these young athletes is so fulfilling. I'm glad my experiences can help shape their future and inspire them to go after their dreams.
[D14:12] Tim: You're doing a great job with them. Way to go! This is what I've been up to.
[D14:13] John: Wow, stunning! And thanks. Really appreciate it. Means a lot.
[D14:14] Tim: I took this pic last summer. Seeing it was so stunning. Thanks for appreciating it. It means a lot to me.
[D14:15] John: Where did you capture this? Nature is truly amazing, isn't it?
[D14:16] Tim: I snapped that pic on my trip to the Smoky Mountains last year. It was incredible seeing it in person. Nature's really something else!
[D14:17] John: Yeah, it's amazing how nature's beauty and grandeur can take our breath away. It's so nice to escape the noise of the city and relax in nature. Good for you to get to enjoy that stunning view!
[D14:18] Tim: Nature is indeed refreshing. A good break from school.
[D14:19] John: How are you doing in shcool?
[D14:20] Tim: Doing good! Busy with studies but finding time to relax with books - good balance.
[D14:21] John: Cool! Finding that balance is key. Are you currently reading any books?
[D14:22] Tim: I'm reading this book and I'm totally hooked! What about you?
[D14:23] John: I haven't had much time to read, but after we talked I finally picked up a book and it's been awesome! Talk to you later!
[D15:1] Tim: Hey John! Haven't talked to you in a bit but wanted to let you know I read this awesome book about castles in the UK. It was so interesting and blew me away! I dream of visiting them one day.
[D15:2] John: Hey Tim! Great to hear from you. Learning about different cultures and seeing historical architecture fascinates me. Visiting castles is really on my bucket list. [D15:9] Tim: I've been reading her stuff for a long time. Her stories have been with me and still inspire me. There's something special about her writing that really speaks to me.
[D15:10] John: Wow, some authors really have such an influence on us! They become part of our life and affect our interests. Do you have a favorite J.K. Rowling quote?

[D15:12] John: Nice quote! It reminds us to stay positive and find joy even in hard times. It's a guiding light when things get rough. I appreciate you sharing it!

[D15:15] Tim: That's awesome! Visual reminders and strategies can really help in staying motivated. It's cool that you have those quotes to keep you going during tough workouts.
[D15:16] John: This plaque I keep on my desk is a constant reminder to believe in myself. It helps me trust my abilities and face any obstacles. Having physical reminders like this really helps me stay motivated.
[D15:17] Tim: That's awesome! What keeps you motivated during challenging times?

[D15:21] Tim: That's key, having a strong support network can really help with what we're trying to do. Do you have people you can lean on outside of sports?

[D15:23] Tim: Awesome! Having people who lift us up is essential. I'm grateful I have friends and family who support me - it's huge.
[D15:24] John: Having loved ones who support us is so important. My family is always there for me.
[D15:25] Tim: Wow, look at this great group! Are these your people?
